title: Prior-Trouble Allowance on Calibration Workmanship Warranty Goodwill
content:
**Clause.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a calibration prior-trouble allowance is added into the calibration goodwill sum on a Calibration Workmanship Warranty. The calibration prior-trouble allowance follows the inspections on the coverage that found a concern covered: two or more such inspections, the two-finding prior-trouble allowance of USD 3.00; exactly one, the one-finding prior-trouble allowance of USD 1.50; none, no calibration prior-trouble allowance.

| Inspections on the coverage that found a concern covered | Calibration prior-trouble allowance |
|---|---|
| none | none |
| exactly one | USD 1.50 |
| two or more | USD 3.00 |

## Scope

- Every inspection on the coverage with a covered determination counts, whatever the concern and whenever it took place.
- Inspections that found a concern not covered do not count.

## Hypothetical cases

1. A coverage with one earlier calibration-fault inspection found covered and a later one found not covered: one covered finding, USD 1.50.
2. A coverage with two covered findings on different concerns: USD 3.00.
3. A coverage whose only inspection found a concern not covered: no allowance.
